anonSubtagline: Log every listen with zero friction, rate it with stars and a score if you want, and follow other listeners to discover what they're spinning.
feature1Body: Every listen goes into your diary with zero friction — first listen, relisten, rediscovery — plus private notes if you want.
feature2Body: Half-stars from 0.5 to 5 and an optional 1 to 100 score. An expression of identity, not an objective average.
feature3Body: Comment on artists, albums and songs. Here a review is content in itself, not just another data point.
feature4Body: Mark your favorite artists, records and songs, and choose who can see them.
feature5Body: Curated collections with manual ordering and the visibility you want: private, followers, or public.
feature6Body: Vinyl, CDs and cassettes with edition, pressing, condition and format detail, plus a free note.
feature7Body: An explicit, one-way graph. See what they listen to, rate and comment on. Discovery through people, never an algorithm.
feature8Body: Real feats, collaborations, editions and remasters. It tells the person from the band: Pink Floyd ↔ Roger Waters.
feature9Body: Public or private profile, per-item audience, follow requests and blocks. You decide what's shared.

anonClosingTitle: Your listening history starts with an account.
